mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_buy_market_better.trade_order (order_no, user_id, user_tag, order_status, total_amount, pay_amount, discount_amount, entry_source, order_create_time, order_expire_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{userTag}, #{orderStatus}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{entrySource}, #{orderCreateTime}, #{orderExpireTime}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, user_id, user_tag, order_status, total_amount, pay_amount, discount_amount, entry_source, pay_channel, order_create_time, order_expire_time, order_end_time, create_time, update_time FROM group_buy_market_better.trade_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT order_no, user_id, user_tag, order_status, total_amount, pay_amount, discount_amount, entry_source, pay_channel, order_create_time, order_expire_time, order_end_time FROM group_buy_market_better.trade_order WHERE order_expire_time <= now() AND order_status = 0

SELECT order_no, user_id, user_tag, order_status, total_amount, pay_amount, discount_amount, entry_source, pay_channel, order_create_time, order_expire_time, order_end_time, create_time, update_time FROM group_buy_market_better.trade_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY order_create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
